basic_info.description: Spacious Marina-style detached home in the heart of San Francisco's Portola district offers the perfect blend of space, character, and convenience. Featuring five bedrooms and three bathrooms, hardwood floors, large kitchen with ample cabinetry and counter space, ideal for family cooking and entertaining. Extra wide lot that offers huge potential and room to expand. 2-car attached garage for secure, convenient parking. Enjoy the large beautiful front deck with spectacular city views while benefiting from a quiet, residential street. Just a block away from McLaren park and close to shops and restaurants. Easy access to Freeway 101 and 280. Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity.
